name: Receive Tender
what: Tender logged in system with key fields extracted; tender ID assigned.
include_items: Customer, scope, deadline, submission format, contractual rights flags, all received artefacts filed in repository.

name: Notify Heads of (HL view + schedule)
what: Approved high-level view, response posture (light/tailored/mastery) and proposed schedule.
when_condition: Within 24h of receipt; Sales Director approval starts SLA clock.
include_items: Customer brief, why customer is in market, key dates, proposed response posture, RACI-driven distribution list, schedule mapped to Day 0–12 timeline.

name: Interpret to create requirements
what: Requirements set finalised: scope, key dates, contractual rights, submission format and method.
include_items: Why customer is in market, UK/Global scope, Play to Win commercial context, data factsheet, submission format/method.

name: Generate initial financial view
what: Templated initial view: rules, existing info, data, risks, cost model, price model. Initial MPL draft produced.
when_condition: Day 1–2, in parallel with requirements interpretation.
include_items: Operational availability, ramp variability, fleet/aircraft type/load factor inputs, comparative airlines, single source of truth for cost data, initial MPL draft.

name: Brief Heads of
what: Heads of briefed on the initial view ahead of the strategy meeting.
when_condition: Day 2 morning; prior to strategy + floor meeting.
include_items: Templated brief generated from tender record; financial view summary; initial MPL context; meeting logistics.

name: Agree response strategy + floor
what: Approved response strategy, floor, parameters, detail of response (light/tailored/mastery).
include_items: Templated agenda (intro, key metrics, win strategy, sense-check, decision); decisions recorded in-app; audit trail.

name: Submit recommendation to ET
what: Recommendation pack submitted to Executive Team.
include_items: Opportunity intro, key metrics review, win strategy, model sense-check, recommendation.

name: ET Go / No-Go
what: Go or No-Go decision recorded with audit trail.
when_condition: Within 24 hours of recommendation submission (board SLA).
include_items: Decision (Go/No-Go), rationale, audit trail, delegation rule applied (where below threshold).

name: More detailed response? (branch)
what: Routing decision: full element loop, or light path direct to collation.
include_items: Routing rule applied; branch decision recorded against tender.

name: Communicate strategy + assign elements
what: Strategy communicated; eight Heads of Function assigned to elements.
include_items: Element grid (owner, due date, template status); criteria each element will be measured against; per-element notifications.

name: Element loop — Prepare → Review → Approve → Refine (×8)
what: Eight proposal elements built in parallel via the Prepare/Review/Approve/Refine loop.
include_items: Element drafts using current rate cards, APL, recipe database, supply-chain data; SLAs per element; loop closure logged.

name: Element exceptions (APL / pricing)
what: Exceptions raised and routed per RACI (procurement-by-exception, pricing override).
when_condition: Within the Day 3–5 loop, as they arise.
include_items: Exception flag type, evidence, routing decision, sign-off audit.

name: Update financial model + finalise MPL
what: Financial model updated AND Master Price List (MPL) finalised — the priced view the customer will see.
include_items: MPL collates: F&B costs, non-F&B costs, service charges, overheads, pre-agreed margin applied; versioned model.

name: Collate parts of proposal
what: All parts assembled into the submission pack.
when_condition: Day 10, after model update; templated outputs assemble automatically.
include_items: Element outputs, financial model, MPL, recipe pack, win strategy narrative, audit trail; gaps highlighted.

name: Review outputs vs strategy
what: Variance check: collated outputs vs Day 2 strategy and floor.
include_items: Variance flags vs floor, criteria-met checklist, sign-off readiness; MPL alignment with agreed floor and pricing parameters.

name: Submit pack + co-approve
what: Full proposal pack submitted to ET, co-approved by Sales Director and Finance Director.
when_condition: Day 11 morning; ET approval window opens.
include_items: Templated approval flow recording content, role, decision; full audit trail; function-level sign-offs.

name: ET approve submission pack
what: Final ET sign-off on the full submission proposal.
when_condition: Day 11, before Day 12 submission to customer.
include_items: Decision, audit trail, sign-off list (CEO, COO, CFO, function-level C/I).

name: Submit proposal to customer
what: Proposal sent to customer in required format.
include_items: Submission format and method, customer access details, what was sent vs what was asked for, timestamp.

name: Negotiation, contracting, further submissions, audits
what: Tender continues as a live case through to contract and operational handover.
when_condition: Post-submission to contract signature and beyond.
include_items: Negotiation record, contract version, further-submission record, MPL revisions, menu presentation outcomes, site visit notes, audit outcomes.
